Standard slide panel rectangle for a slide format

Source: R/ph-location.R
hv_panel_box.Rd

The one fixed panel rectangle every plot slide of a slide format anchors its plotting panel to, in inches. The slide format is the slide's aspect ratio: "wide" is 16:9, 13.333 by 7.5 in, the size of every bundled HVTI template; "standard" is 4:3, 10 by 7.5 in. The color template does not matter: the dark, light and slate templates get the same rectangle. save_ppt() and hv_add_plot() read the format from the template's slide size and use this rectangle by default. Axis text, axis titles, facet strips and plot titles flow outside it; hv_fit_location() keeps them on the slide and out of the slide title.

Usage

hv_panel_box(
  mode = c("dark", "light", "slate"),
  format = c("wide", "standard")
)

Arguments

mode

"dark", "light" or "slate". Kept for backward compatibility: every color template gets the same rectangle, so it has no effect.

format

"wide" (16:9, the default) or "standard" (4:3, provisional).

Value

A named list width, height, left, top, in inches, ready for the panel_box argument of save_ppt() and hv_add_plot().

Details

The wide rectangle is 9.98 by 4.11 in, 2.9 in from the left edge and 1.85 in from the top. The numbers leave room for the chrome around the panel:

  • 2.9 in on the left for long y-axis labels and the rotated y-axis title;

  • about 0.45 in above the panel, below the title placeholder that ends at 1.33 in, for facet strips and plot titles;

  • 1.54 in below the panel (7.5 - 1.85 - 4.11), or 1.49 in inside the 0.05 in slide edge, for the x-axis chrome of theme_hv_ppt_dark(), theme_hv_ppt_light() and theme_hv_ppt_slate(): their 32 pt x-axis text and 40 pt x-axis title with its margin need about 1.48 in in Arial Bold, so a plot in these themes fits at full size.

The standard (4:3) rectangle is provisional: no 4:3 template is bundled, and the rectangle has not yet been checked on a real 4:3 deck. It follows the same rules, assuming the 4:3 title placeholder also ends near 1.33 in: the same top (1.85 in) and height (4.11 in), 2.3 in on the left for y labels and 0.45 in on the right, so 7.25 by 4.11 in at 2.3 in left.

In hvtiPlotR 2.8.14 and 2.8.15 both rectangles were 4.15 in high. Through hvtiPlotR 2.8.13 the rectangle was 8.79 by 3.9 in at 2.67 in left, 1.6 in top. Pass panel_box = list(width = 8.79, height = 3.9, left = 2.67, top = 1.6) to save_ppt() or hv_add_plot() to rebuild an old deck at its old geometry.

See also

save_ppt(), hv_add_plot(), hv_fit_location(), hv_ph_location()

Examples

hv_panel_box()
#> $width
#> [1] 9.98
#> 
#> $height
#> [1] 4.11
#> 
#> $left
#> [1] 2.9
#> 
#> $top
#> [1] 1.85
#> 
hv_panel_box(format = "standard")
#> $width
#> [1] 7.25
#> 
#> $height
#> [1] 4.11
#> 
#> $left
#> [1] 2.3
#> 
#> $top
#> [1] 1.85
#>
